SectorPreset.isLastSector: If true, this sector is the final sector of the planet's campaign.
SectorPreset.requireUnlock: If true, the sector must be unlocked before landing.
SectorPreset.planet: The planet to which the current sector belongs.
SectorPreset.addStartingItems: Whether to automatically add initial supplies at the start.
SectorPreset.noLighting: Whether to disable dynamic lighting effects.
SectorPreset.showSectorLandInfo: Whether to show detailed information on the sector landing interface.
SectorPreset.startWaveTimeMultiplier: Multiplier for the time until the first enemy wave arrives.
SectorPreset.captureWave: The minimum wave number required to capture this sector.
SectorPreset.fileName: The map file name corresponding to this sector.
SectorPreset.generator: The terrain generator configuration for the sector.
SectorPreset.sector: The raw data object of this sector.

RegionPart.color: The main color of the part.
RegionPart.colorTo: The color at the end of the animation.
RegionPart.mirror: Whether to automatically generate a mirrored copy on the other side.
RegionPart.rotation: Initial rotation angle of the part (degrees).
RegionPart.originX: X offset of the rotation center.
RegionPart.originY: Y offset of the rotation center.
RegionPart.moveX: Extra movement relative to initial x during animation.
RegionPart.x: X offset of the part relative to the unit/building center.
RegionPart.y: Y offset of the part relative to the unit/building center.
RegionPart.heatLight: Whether to enable heat glow effect.
RegionPart.outline: Whether to draw outlines (automatically generated based on regions).
RegionPart.drawRegion: Whether to draw the main texture.
RegionPart.name: Texture name used.
RegionPart.moveY: Extra movement relative to initial y during animation.
RegionPart.growX: Extra x size multiplier for deformation animation.
RegionPart.growY: Extra y size multiplier for deformation animation.
RegionPart.mixColorTo: Mix color at the end of animation.
RegionPart.replaceOutline: Whether to replace the existing outline (instead of overlaying).
RegionPart.clampProgress: Whether to be limited by animation progress.

Weapon.name: Display weapon texture region.
Weapon.mirror: Whether to create a mirrored copy of this weapon on initialization. Default true.
Weapon.shootX: X offset of bullet/effect relative to weapon center.
Weapon.x: X position offset of the weapon on the unit.
Weapon.otherSide: Internal value for alternating fire; do not change!

mindustry.ai.UnitStance.icon: Icon displayed in UI for this stance.
mindustry.ai.UnitStance.incompatibleCommands: List of incompatible commands. If the unit has both this stance and executes these commands, conflict occurs.
mindustry.ai.UnitStance.incompatibleStances: List of incompatible stances. If the unit has other stances, this stance becomes invalid.
mindustry.ai.UnitStance.toggle: Whether it is a toggle stance.

mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.exactArrival: Whether to arrive exactly at the target position.
mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.icon: Icon displayed in UI for this command.
mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.switchToMove: After executing this command, whether to automatically switch back to normal move command.
mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.drawTarget: Whether to show target indicator line.
mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.snapToBuilding: Whether the target will be a nearby friendly building (similar to 'enter payload' command).
mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.resetTarget: When switching to this command, whether to clear the ongoing behavior queue.
mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.refreshOnSelect: Whether to refresh stance list when selected.
mindustry.ai.UnitCommand.extraStances: List of extra stances activated when executing this command.

mindustry.ai.ItemUnitStance.item:
The target mineral to mine.
[stat] Prioritizes the mineral with the least amount in the core among target minerals.

mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent.databaseTabs: Which planets' core database this appears in.
mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent.alwaysUnlocked: Whether it is unlocked in the tech tree.
mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent.hideDatabase: Whether to hide in the core database.
mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent.generateIcons: Whether to automatically generate UI and full icons for this content.
mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent.inlineDescription: Whether the description text is displayed on the same line in the UI.

RainWeather.yspeed: Vertical falling speed of raindrops (positive downward).
RainWeather.padding: Render margin. Particles outside this margin from screen are not rendered.
RainWeather.density: Particle density. Higher value means more raindrops per unit area.
RainWeather.splashTimeScale: Splash animation speed, controls the duration of splash effects when raindrops hit the ground.
RainWeather.splashes: Texture set for splashes. Played in sequence to produce splash animation.

Weather.opacityMultiplier: Opacity multiplier, controls visibility of weather effects.
Weather.hidden: Whether to hide this weather in the core database.
Weather.sound: Sound effect looped for weather event.
Weather.soundVolOscMag: Volume oscillation amplitude, causing periodic volume change.
Weather.statusAir: Whether to apply status effect to air units.
Weather.statusGround: Whether to apply status effect to ground units.
Weather.attrs: Attributes affected by weather (e.g., light, temperature; usually defaults).

ParticleWeather.force: Magnitude of extra force applied to units.
ParticleWeather.useWindVector: Whether to use wind direction vector.
ParticleWeather.padding: Render margin. Particles outside this margin from screen are not rendered.
ParticleWeather.density: Particle density. Higher value means fewer particles per unit area.
ParticleWeather.sinSclMin: Minimum sine wave scale. Controls the minimum density of particle path waves.
ParticleWeather.randomParticleRotation: Whether to randomly rotate particle textures.
ParticleWeather.drawNoise: Whether to draw the noise texture layer.
ParticleWeather.drawParticles: Whether to draw particles (false means only draw noise layer, no particles).
ParticleWeather.sinSclMax: Maximum sine wave scale. Controls the maximum density of particle path waves.
ParticleWeather.sinMagMin: Minimum sine wave magnitude. Minimum range of particle left-right swing.
ParticleWeather.sinMagMax: Maximum sine wave magnitude. Maximum range of particle left-right swing.
ParticleWeather.noiseScale: Noise scale. Larger value makes noise texture sparser.
ParticleWeather.noiseLayers: Number of noise layers. Multiple layers increase texture complexity.
ParticleWeather.noiseLayerSpeedM: Speed multiplier for each noise layer.
ParticleWeather.noiseLayerSclM: Scale multiplier for each noise layer.
ParticleWeather.noiseLayerAlphaM: Opacity multiplier for each noise layer.
ParticleWeather.noiseLayerColorM: Color multiplier for each noise layer.

Liquid.viscosity:
Liquid viscosity. 0.5≈water (viscous), 1 similar to tar (flows slowly).
[stat] Greater than 1 causes infinite spread.
Liquid.gasColor: Color of this liquid in gas state.

Item.hidden: If true, this item is hidden in most interfaces.
Item.color: Color of the item when selected or in progress bars.

HaloPart.mirror: Whether to automatically generate a mirrored copy on the other side.
HaloPart.sides: Number of sides of the polygon.
HaloPart.radiusTo: Size at the end of animation.
HaloPart.strokeTo: Thickness of edge at end of animation.
HaloPart.triLengthTo: Height length of the cone at end of animation.
HaloPart.haloRadiusTo: Radius of the outer halo at end of animation.
HaloPart.haloRotateSpeed: Continuous rotation speed of the outer halo (degrees/frame).
HaloPart.rotateSpeed: Continuous rotation speed of the shape itself (degrees/frame).
HaloPart.shapeMoveRot: Rotation change of the shape during animation.
HaloPart.x: X offset of the shape relative to unit/building center.
HaloPart.y: Y offset of the shape relative to unit/building center.
HaloPart.clampProgress: Whether to be limited by animation progress.
HaloPart.moveY: Extra movement relative to initial y during animation.
HaloPart.moveX: Extra movement relative to initial x during animation.

DrawPart.weaponIndex: Which weapon this is associated with.
DrawPart.recoilIndex: Which recoil animation this is associated with.
DrawPart.under: Whether to render under the unit/building body.
DrawPart.turretShading: Whether to be affected by turret shadow system.

EffectSpawnerPart.x: X offset of effect spawn point.
EffectSpawnerPart.y: Y offset of effect spawn point.
EffectSpawnerPart.effectIntervalFrom: From which progress to start triggering.
EffectSpawnerPart.useProgress: Whether to trigger based on animation progress.
EffectSpawnerPart.mirror: Whether to automatically generate a mirrored copy on the other side.

FlarePart.followRotation: Whether to follow part's rotation direction.
FlarePart.clampProgress: Whether to be limited by animation progress.

HoverPart.rotation: Overall rotation angle of hover wave (degrees).
HoverPart.phase: Phase offset of hover wave animation.
HoverPart.minStroke: Minimum thickness of hover lines during animation.
HoverPart.sides: Number of sides of hover wave.
HoverPart.mirror: Whether to automatically generate a mirrored copy on the other side.
HoverPart.x: X offset of hover wave relative to unit/building center.
HoverPart.y: Y offset of hover wave relative to unit/building center.

ShapePart.mirror: Whether to automatically generate a mirrored copy on the other side.
ShapePart.clampProgress: Whether to be limited by animation progress.
ShapePart.strokeTo: Thickness of edge at end of animation.
ShapePart.x: X offset of shape relative to unit/building center.
ShapePart.y: Y offset of shape relative to unit/building center.
ShapePart.moveX: Extra movement relative to initial x during animation.
ShapePart.moveY: Extra movement relative to initial y during animation.
ShapePart.rotateSpeed: Continuous rotation speed of shape itself (degrees/frame).

BulletType.scaleKeepVelocity: Whether to reduce bullet lifetime proportionally based on attached speed to keep range consistent.
BulletType.trailInterp: Interpolation method for trail width over bullet lifetime.
BulletType.scaleLife: Whether to scale lifetime (not speed) to disappear at target position. Commonly used for artillery shells.
BulletType.fragOnAbsorb: If false, fragmentation bullets are not generated when absorbed by shields.
BulletType.fragBullet: Fragmentation bullet type generated when this bullet ends.

Planet.visible: Whether to show in planet selection screen.
Planet.accessible: Whether players can land on or visit this planet.
Planet.totalRadius: Total radius of planet and all its satellites/rings.
Planet.lightColor: Color of main light source of planet.
Planet.iconColor: Color of planet icon in UI.
Planet.drawOrbit: Whether to draw the planet's orbital path in the star map.
Planet.defaultEnv: Default environment type for sectors on this planet.
Planet.allowWaves: Whether to allow enemy wave attacks.
Planet.allowSectorInvasion: Whether to allow enemy invasion from adjacent sectors.
Planet.allowLaunchLoadout: Whether to allow players to customize resources carried when launching.
Planet.allowLaunchSchematics: Whether to allow players to carry custom schematics when launching.
Planet.allowLaunchToNumbered: Whether to allow players to launch to procedurally generated numbered sectors.
Planet.allowSelfSectorLaunch: Whether to allow players to launch from the current sector to the same sector again.
Planet.clearSectorOnLose: Whether to clear sector save data when the player loses it.
Planet.prebuildBase: Whether to pre-build a ring of basic buildings around the core upon landing.
Planet.startSector: Index of the default starting sector.
Planet.sectorSeed: Random seed for sector content generation.
Planet.launchMusic: Music played when selecting this planet on the planet interface.
Planet.defaultCore: Default core block type used when landing on this planet.
Planet.orbitTime: Time for one orbit in seconds.
Planet.rotateTime: Time for one rotation in seconds.
Planet.orbitOffset: Random starting angle offset of orbit.
Planet.tidalLock: Whether tidal locked (the side facing the parent star remains constant).
Planet.camRadius: Camera distance offset relative to planet.
Planet.icon: Icon name used for planet in UI.
Planet.enemyCoreSpawnReplace: Whether enemy core is replaced by enemy spawn point.
Planet.allowCampaignRules: Whether to allow players to adjust campaign rules in planet selection screen.
Planet.showRtsAIRule: Whether to show RTS AI related options in rules.
Planet.launchCapacityMultiplier: Multiplier for core item capacity per launch.
Planet.sectors: List of all sectors on this planet.
Planet.sectorApproxRadius: Approximate radius of a single sector.
Planet.loadPlanetData: Whether to load extra planet data.
Planet.updateLighting: Whether to dynamically update planet lighting.
Planet.lightSrcFrom: Start angle range of light source.
Planet.lightSrcTo: End angle range of light source.
Planet.lightDstFrom: Start angle range of light target.
Planet.lightDstTo: End angle range of light target.
Planet.techTree: Tech tree root node for this planet.
Planet.autoAssignPlanet: Whether to automatically mark tech tree content on this planet as belonging to it.
Planet.unlockedOnLand: List of content automatically unlocked upon landing on this planet.
Planet.parent: Parent star that this planet orbits.
Planet.children: List of child planets orbiting this planet.
Planet.solarSystem: Root solar system node that this planet belongs to.
Planet.launchCandidates: List of target planets that can be launched to from this planet.
Planet.updateGroup: List of planets allowed to update lighting simultaneously.
Planet.campaignRules: Rule configuration for this planet's campaign mode.
Planet.sectorCaptureReplacements: Replacement configuration when sector is captured.
Planet.allowLegacyLaunchPads: Whether to allow using old version launch pad mechanics.
Planet.statParent: Parent category this content belongs to in statistics.
Planet.position: Coordinate position of planet on star map.
Planet.enemyFactoryActivationDelay: Delay before enemy base unit production factories start working for the first time.

Sector.generateEnemyBase: Whether to generate an enemy base in this sector.
Sector.preset: Preset template name used for this sector.
Sector.tile: Terrain data structure for each tile in the sector.
Sector.rect: Rectangle boundary range of sector in planet grid.

mindustry.maps.generators.FileMapGenerat.preset: Preset template name used for this sector.
mindustry.maps.generators.FileMapGenerat.map: List of maps used for this sector.

UnitType.segmentRegions: List of body texture regions for segment units.
UnitType.wreckRegions: List of texture regions displayed as wreckage after unit destruction.
UnitType.segmentCellRegions: List of core battery texture regions for segment units.
UnitType.segmentOutlineRegions: List of outline texture regions for segment units.
UnitType.totalRequirements: List of all research requirements sum for unit or building in tech tree.
UnitType.cachedRequirements: Cached list of build or research requirements.
UnitType.firstRequirements: List of basic research requirements for first unlock of unit or building.

Block.breakEffect: Effect when destroying this block. Size is passed as rotation parameter.

CellLiquid.cells: Number of cells per cell-liquid tile.

Consume.booster: Whether it is a booster consumption.

ShieldArcAbility.region: If not null, rendered on top layer.
